title: tier-2: build a 4x4 projection matrix from a descriptor (reverse-Z aware)
notes: Zero named callees; pure leaf at 0x142075a70 (Overwatch.exe / current build).
param_3 != 0 selects the reverse-Z near/far mapping (negated m22/m32).
The out matrix is 16 floats, column-major, all slots written.
Float op order matches the decompile so bit patterns agree with the oracle.
Return value is the out pointer; declared void so arena vs host addresses are not compared.
allowedImageReads: 0x7ff7c7c9aae4 = 1.0f literal, 0x7ff7c7ca17a0 = -0.0f (XORPS sign mask). Both are .rdata compiler constants the decompile already inlines; not game globals.
